items.title: Treehouse TREE — UUPS upgrade adding Blacklistable
items.summary: Upgrades the TREE governance token (not tETH) and installs a 5-of-7 Safe as blacklister: a zero-delay transfer-freeze role after execution.

items.title: Lombard — AssetRouter, BTC.b and LBTC upgrades adding a fixed deposit fee
items.summary: Three ProxyAdmin.upgradeAndCall ops (no init call) upgrade AssetRouter, BTC.b (NativeLBTC) and LBTC (StakedLBTC): a per-token deposit fee is split off every proof mint to treasury (OPERATOR_ROLE may set 100-1,000 sats, the timelock anything up to half the minimum), a router-wide minRequestAmount replaces depositMinAmount, and unpauseTransfers moves from DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to MANAGER_ROLE.

operations.label: AssetRouter upgrade adding a fixed deposit fee
BTC.b token upgrade that charges the deposit fee on mint
LBTC token upgrade; unpausing transfers moves to the manager role

items.title: Ethena USDe — mint caps cut to 50M per block, USDm delisted, a custodian added
items.summary: Four ops: global and per-asset maxMintPerBlock 200M -> 50M USDe on 8 assets; removeSupportedAsset(USDm); addCustodianAddress for an EOA not yet a custodian; USDe OFT adapter setRateLimits to 25M per hour on LayerZero eids 30339 (was 10M) and 30383 (was 30M).

operations.label: mint caps cut from 200M to 50M per block
bridge rate limits set to 25M per hour on two routes

items.title: ether.fi — LayerZero V2 delegate moved behind the 10-day timelock
items.summary: EtherfiL1SyncPoolETH.setDelegate(EtherFiTimelock): protective hardening of the OApp's messaging configuration.

items.title: Yearn V3 — 8 new strategies added to 6 vaults with max-debt caps
items.summary: One 16-call batch: add_strategy(strategy, add_to_queue=false) then update_max_debt_for_strategy on yvUSDC-1, yvUSD, yvWETH-1, yvWETH-2, yvFlexUSDC and yvFlexWETH (Flex siUSD and wstETH lenders / loopers, USDC-to-yvUSDS-1 depositors). Caps range from 10,000 WETH to 10B USDC (yvFlexUSDC, effectively uncapped).

items.title: Beefy CLM USDC-VVV on Aerodrome — calm-check tolerance widened from 9 to 25 ticks
items.summary: setDeviation(25) on the cowAeroBaseUSDC-VVV strategy (owned by the timelock): maxTickDeviation 9 -> 25 ticks, the tolerance between the pool tick and its 120 s TWAP before the strategy acts, on a tick-spacing-50 Aerodrome pool. No code change.

items.title: Ethena USDe — RLUSD & USAT collateral onboarding
items.summary: Two queued EthenaMinting.addSupportedAsset calls onboard RLUSD and USAT at 200M / 20M USDe-per-block caps (stablesDeltaLimit = 0 bps).
